schema_note: proposal-only obstruction/lesson; not retained semantic learning
trigger_signature: one or more cited foundational sources inaccessible
lesson_candidate: When a pre-candidate discriminator is a bounded negative theorem-family inventory, inaccessible full primary text is a first-class source obstruction. Route to acquisition/retrieval rather than mathematical invention; abstracts may support positive headline claims but cannot close the negative inventory.
boundaries: Does not imply that the missing sources contain a useful theorem.
Does not imply that the inspected sources contain no other useful methods outside the frozen discriminator.
Does not authorize a mathematical candidate or lower-bound claim.
Does not count as retained RAKL learning until a protected lesson/admission gate succeeds.
framework_improvement_hypothesis: Add a typed source-completeness residual/admission check that can block a cycle before candidate generation and enforce presence of RAKL_CYCLE_METRICS whenever a TaskEpisode/case-study artifact is emitted.
